purpose: Recover authority when a prior durable owner is stale without duplicating substantive work. Under the active rolling runtime, normal completion-relative wake is reconstruction/continuation, not a fixed-quarter predecessor/successor handoff protocol.
normal_path: On a valid same-canonical rolling wake, verify newest schedule generation, provisionally rearm, reconstruct exact durable checkpoint, then claim a fresh authority epoch when the prior run is no longer active. Do not require a clock-bound handoff request.

already_stale_fast_path.rationale: Do not add a second 120-second idle tax when predecessor was already stale for the full recovery grace.

legacy_note: Version 2 request/ack wording reflected the retired fixed-quarter rolling-worker design. Historical evidence remains valid; active recovery semantics follow rolling completion-relative lifecycle.
